meta.model: Model (linear, about the static state; body x forward, y left, z up; gravity -z; leg order FL FR RL RR): * configuration "legs" (levelled, crawler clear): the L1 ball-centre 6-DoF of l1r_reference.Level (rev. 13), leg springs k2 (head only = moving / L1) or k1 (L1-R LOCK), pad dashpot c_n (YAML, LOCK basis), bushing k_t, c_t; * configuration "crawler+legs" (touch phase, top): crawler roller springs (YAML layout D, vertical only, no tangential restraint = R8) + the four legs k2 at the touch extension; preload shared by stiffness (static_unilateral); * actuator option under test: command v_cmd held for 0.1 s (10 Hz ZOH), applied speed v_f = first-order lag tau_v of v_cmd (tau_v 0 = ideal valve), leg extension e' = v_f (rigid motor, no force limit); * leg force N = k (e - a_z q) + c (v_f - a_z q') (pad force; cylinder force = N - m_rod g, rod inertia neglected); quasi-static N_qs(e) = elastic statics for the same e; dynamic d = N - N_qs. Scenarios: one 10 Hz step (v_max -> 0 "stop" from steady motion, 0 -> v_max "start") of: all four legs (heave), single legs, pairs; per leg the adversarial bound max_t sum_i |d_ji(t)| over sign patterns of simultaneous steps (each leg stepping by v_max); a per-mode decomposition of d after the step and its 10 Hz alias frequencies. Deterministic. usage: run_valve_step_check.py [out.json] (dynamics-dev, E-cores, about 1 min)
meta.units: forces N (pad = cylinder + m_rod g; dynamic part d = N - N_qs), frequencies Hz
